## What

One paragraph: what is wrong or what should exist, from the user's or the owner's perspective.

## Where it came from

Lesson row, judge finding, review comment, user, owner idea; link the origin issue or PR if there is one.

## Evidence

Command output, report path, screenshot description. Never transcripts, audio or secrets.
